items.title: British man recalls ‘despair’ over son’s death after fall from Cyprus window

sentences.en: British man recalls ‘despair’ over son’s death after fall from Cyprus window.
sentences.zh: 一名英国男子回忆起儿子从塞浦路斯窗户坠落身亡后的“绝望”。

sentences.en: Joshua Foster tells of moment he ‘lost control’ of two-year-old when he fell from fourth storey of hotel A British father who was fined by the courts after his two-year-old son fell from a fourth-floor window during a family holiday in Cyprus has recalled his “despair” when the boy slipped from his grasp.
sentences.zh: Joshua Foster讲述了他“失控”导致两岁儿子从酒店四楼坠落的时刻。这位英国父亲在塞浦路斯度假期间，因两岁儿子从四楼窗户坠落而被法院处以罚款，他回忆起儿子从他手中滑落时的“绝望”。

sentences.en: Joshua Foster was handed a €3,000 (£2,500) penalty after he pleaded guilty to a charge of causing death through a reckless, rash or dangerous act.
sentences.zh: Joshua Foster在对因鲁莽、轻率或危险行为造成死亡的指控认罪后，被处以3000欧元（2500英镑）的罚款。

sentences.en: Prosecutors in Cyprus had refused to drop the case against him.
sentences.zh: 塞浦路斯检察官拒绝撤销对他的起诉。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: Denmark to expel Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill US-Ukrainian rapper

sentences.en: Denmark to expel Russian diplomat over alleged plot to kill US-Ukrainian rapper.
sentences.zh: 丹麦将驱逐涉嫌策划暗杀美籍乌克兰说唱歌手的俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: Moscow intelligence thought to be behind plan to kill musician Kyivstoner before concert in Denmark Denmark’s foreign minister has said Russia’s defence attache in Copenhagen would be expelled after Moscow was suspected of being behind an attempted killing of a US-Ukrainian rapper.
sentences.zh: 莫斯科情报部门被认为策划了在丹麦音乐会前刺杀音乐人Kyivstoner的行动。丹麦外交部长表示，在莫斯科被怀疑策划刺杀一名美籍乌克兰说唱歌手的未遂行动后，丹麦将驱逐俄罗斯驻哥本哈根的国防武官。

sentences.en: “We have just summoned the Russian ambassador to the ministry of foreign affairs and notified him of the government’s decision to expel the Russian defence attache from Denmark,” Lars Løkke Rasmussen told a news conference.
sentences.zh: “我们刚刚召见俄罗斯驻丹麦大使，并向他通报了丹麦政府驱逐俄罗斯国防武官的决定。”拉斯·洛克·拉森在新闻发布会上表示。

sentences.en: The expulsion will happen within seven days.
sentences.zh: 驱逐将在七天内执行。

items.title: Senate permitting bill speeds up renewables, divides greens over oil and gas

sentences.en: Senate permitting bill speeds up renewables, divides greens over oil and gas.
sentences.zh: 参议院许可法案加快了可再生能源的发展，使环保人士在石油和天然气问题上产生分歧。

sentences.en: A permitting reform bill in the Senate could help speed the development of renewable energy projects, but it's splitting environmentalists over other provisions that help the oil and gas industry.

items.title: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño

sentences.en: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño.
sentences.zh: 房屋被弃，收成歉收：海地的农民在暴力、饥饿和厄尔尼诺现象中重建家园。

sentences.en: Years of insecurity, violence perpetrated by murderous armed gangs and economic instability, combined with displacement, poor agricultural performance and climate shocks, have left millions of Haitians struggling to meet their food needs.
sentences.zh: 多年来，海地饱受不安全局势、凶残武装团伙的暴力行为和经济不稳定的困扰，再加上流离失所、农业歉收和气候冲击，导致数百万海地人难以满足粮食需求。

items.title: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen

sentences.en: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen.
sentences.zh: “我们只带走了性命逃离家园”：在饱受战乱蹂躏的也门艰难分娩。

sentences.en: When fighting suddenly escalated around Taiz, in southwestern Yemen two months ago, midwife Anisa Fadhl had no time to pack a bag before she fled, leaving behind her home and her clinic.
sentences.zh: 两个月前，也门西南部塔伊兹周边的战事突然升级，助产士阿尼萨·法德尔（Anisa Fadhl）来不及收拾行李就逃离了家和诊所。

sentences.en: Both were later looted and destroyed.
sentences.zh: 这两座寺庙后来都被洗劫一空并被摧毁。

items.title: Rejoining EU ‘on the table’ as UK makes deals on trade and young people

sentences.en: Rejoining EU ‘on the table’ as UK makes deals on trade and young people.
sentences.zh: 随着英国就贸易和青年问题达成协议，重新加入欧盟“已摆上台面”。

sentences.en: All options open in future talks, says Ed Miliband, while prime minister hails ‘a good day for Britain and Europe’ The UK rejoining the EU could be on the table in informal discussions between Andy Burnham and European leaders in Brussels, Ed Miliband has said.
sentences.zh: 埃德·米利班德表示，在未来的谈判中，所有选项都将摆在桌面上，而首相则称“今天是英国和欧洲的好日子”。埃德·米利班德表示，在安迪·伯纳姆与欧洲领导人在布鲁塞尔举行的非正式会谈中，英国重新加入欧盟的议题可能会被提上议程。

sentences.en: The foreign secretary said “all options” would be examined in the process, after the prime minister agreed deals on trade and young people with the bloc on Friday.
sentences.zh: 在首相周五与欧盟就贸易和青年问题达成协议后，外交大臣表示，在此过程中将考虑“所有方案”。

items.title: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs

sentences.en: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多军队与黑帮作战，海地人既兴奋又不安。

sentences.en: Foreign combatants in Port-au-Prince welcomed by many after years of gang control but some fear offensive could exacerbate volatile situation A bullet-peppered mural of the Haitian striker Emmanuel Sanon covers the facade of Port-au-Prince’s main football ground.
sentences.zh: 在太子港经历了多年的帮派控制后，许多人对外国战斗人员的到来表示欢迎，但也有人担心攻势可能会加剧动荡的局势。太子港主足球场的外墙上有一幅海地前锋埃马纽埃尔·萨农（Emmanuel Sanon）的壁画，上面布满了弹孔。

sentences.en: But more than two years have passed since any sports stars graced the pitch.
sentences.zh: 但自上一次有体育明星亮相球场以来，已经过去了两年多时间。

sentences.en: In 2024, as the surrounding city was almost entirely captured by heavily armed gangs , Sylvio Cator stadium – where football greats including Brazil’s Ronaldo and Roberto Carlos once played – also fell under criminal control, its dilapidated red and blue stands used as an outpost by fighters working for a gang boss called Izo.
sentences.zh: 2024年，随着周边城市几乎完全被全副武装的帮派攻占，西尔维奥·卡托尔体育场——巴西的罗纳尔多和罗伯托·卡洛斯等足球巨星曾在这里踢过球——也落入了犯罪分子的控制之下，其破败的红蓝看台被名为伊佐（Izo）的帮派头目手下的武装分子用作哨所。

sentences.en: Haiti’s national team, the Grenadiers, found itself homeless and was forced to play its World Cup qualifying games abroad .
sentences.zh: 海地国家队“格勒纳迪耶”发现自己无家可归，被迫在国外参加世界杯预选赛。

items.title: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve

sentences.en: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve.
sentences.zh: 中国致力于低碳电气化，并帮助其他国家和地区实现改进。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Countries at Cop31 are being urged to commit to deriving 35% of their energy from electricity by 2035 Cop31 live – latest updates China is pushing for rapid electrification of its economy using low-carbon energy and will help other countries do the same, a senior member of the Chinese delegation at the Cop31 UN climate summit has said.
sentences.zh: 独家报道：COP31与会国正被敦促承诺到2035年实现35%的能源来自电力。COP31直播——最新消息。中国COP31联合国气候峰会代表团的一名高级成员表示，中国正在推动其经济利用低碳能源实现快速电气化，并将帮助其他国家也这样做。

sentences.en: Wang Yi, a professor of energy and environment policy at the Chinese Academy of Sciences and a senior adviser to China’s government, said: “End-use electrification is a very clear direction.
sentences.zh: 中国科学院能源与环境政策教授、中国政府高级顾问王毅表示：“终端电气化是一个非常明确的方向。

sentences.en: We can follow this direction while making the source of electricity clean.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在遵循这一方向的同时，让电力来源变得清洁。

sentences.en: That’s the way to go forward.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 这就是前进的方向。”继续阅读……

items.title: ‘So what if there’s a hole? It hasn’t collapsed’: Kyiv residents unbothered by Russian attacks on city’s bridges

sentences.en: ‘So what if there’s a hole?
sentences.zh: “就算有洞又怎么样？

sentences.en: It hasn’t collapsed’: Kyiv residents unbothered by Russian attacks on city’s bridges.
sentences.zh: “它没有垮塌”：基辅居民对俄罗斯袭击该市桥梁并不感到担忧。

sentences.en: Despite dodging tears in the tarmac, people are confident in city’s infrastructure – and will not worry about what has not happened yet Mykola expects to drive his battered beige passenger minibus 20 to 24 times a day past the holes in the road on Kyiv’s damaged Northern Bridge that were caused by a Russian ballistic missile attack on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 尽管在柏油路上躲避着催泪弹，人们仍对这座城市的基础设施充满信心，不会担心尚未发生的事情。米科拉预计每天会驾驶他那辆破旧的米色客运小巴20至24次，经过基辅受损的北部大桥上因周二俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击而造成的坑洞。

sentences.en: Buses are now the only motor transport allowed across the normally busy multi-lane crossing, though on their way into the city centre they have to skirt the tears in the tarmac, using the only functioning lane to get by.
sentences.zh: 现在，巴士是唯一获准通过这条通常车水马龙的多车道交叉口的机动车辆，不过在驶入市中心的途中，它们必须绕过路面上的裂缝，使用唯一一条还能通行的车道通过。

items.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032

items.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, an Anthropic worker says he may have cracked the biggest

sentences.en: In a year of AI solving maths problems, an Anthropic worker says he may have cracked the biggest.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能解决数学问题的一年里，一位Anthropic的员工表示，他可能已经攻克了最难的难题。

sentences.zh: Anthropic的一位数学家表示，他使用人工智能证明了著名的黎曼猜想，不过验证还需要一些时间。

items.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide

sentences.zh: 美国市场承受着压力，标准普尔500指数和道琼斯工业平均指数被推入回调区间。

items.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler

sentences.en: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler.
sentences.zh: 法国多名警员因殴打音乐制作人米歇尔·泽克勒（Michel Zecler）而被判刑。

sentences.zh: 法院认定2020年殴打黑人音乐制作人的事件属于种族主义加重情节。

items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad

sentences.en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad.
sentences.zh: 特朗普威胁要对在海外建设数据中心的美国科技公司实施“严厉的惩罚”。

sentences.en: President gives wide-ranging White House press conference and says he has ‘fantastic relationships’ with Putin and Xi Donald Trump threatened on Friday to impose “tremendous penalties” on American tech companies that build datacenters outside the US, though he gave no details and told reporters he had not yet informed his own officials about the plan.
sentences.zh: 美国总统召开了一场内容广泛的白宫记者招待会，并表示他与普京和习近平有着“非常好的关系”。唐纳德·特朗普周五威胁称，将对在美国境外建设数据中心的美国科技公司实施“严厉的惩罚”，但他没有提供具体细节，并告诉记者，他尚未将该计划告知自己的政府官员。

sentences.en: In a discursive press conference from the White House briefing room, Trump also said he would “look into” the report that Iran had been planning to possibly detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington DC, and backed JD Vance over comments the vice-president made blaming Republican midterm losses on the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 在白宫简报室举行的一次冗长的记者招待会上，特朗普还表示，他将“调查”关于伊朗可能计划在华盛顿特区引爆“脏弹”的报道，并支持J·D·万斯对副总统将共和党在中期选举中的失利归咎于伊朗战争的言论。

items.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading

sentences.en: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading.
sentences.zh: 受人工智能板块抛售潮影响，Anthropic上市交易的第二天表现不佳，纳斯达克指数抹平了2026年的所有涨幅。

sentences.en: The Nasdaq lost trillions in value, with the AI startup’s IPO failing to buoy it as investors question huge sums being poured into AI buildout Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn?
sentences.zh: 纳斯达克市值蒸发数万亿美元，而人工智能初创企业的IPO未能提振市场，因为投资者对巨额资金投入人工智能建设表示质疑。Anthropic的七位联合创始人是谁？该公司现在的市值达到了1800亿美元。

sentences.en: As Anthropic’s stock dropped during its second day of trading, the wider stock market dipped with it.
sentences.zh: 随着Anthropic的股价在其上市交易的第二天下跌，大盘也随之下跌。

sentences.en: On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January.
sentences.zh: 周五，纳斯达克综合指数抹去了2026年的所有涨幅，收盘较1月1日的市值下跌了5%。

sentences.en: Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO failed to stem a global sell-off in AI-linked companies, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq erased some $4tn in market value this week, according to the Wall Street Journal.
sentences.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic创纪录的IPO未能阻止与人工智能相关的公司的全球抛售潮，本周科技股为主的纳斯达克市值蒸发了约4万亿美元。

items.title: How Cloudflare WAF protects against ruby2shell (CVE-2026-132825)

sentences.en: How Cloudflare WAF protects against ruby2shell (CVE-2026-132825).
sentences.zh: Cloudflare WAF 如何防范 ruby2shell（CVE-2026-132825）。

sentences.en: On November 19, 2026, the Ruby team disclosed ruby2shell ( CVE-2026-132825 ), a heap buffer overflow in the way Ruby changes the case of strings.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月19日，Ruby团队披露了ruby2shell （ CVE-2026-132825 ） ，这是Ruby更改字符串大小写方式中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞。

sentences.en: Ruby rates the flaw Critical and says it is aware of proofs of concept that achieve remote code execution in some scenarios.
sentences.zh: Ruby 将该漏洞评为“严重”级别，并表示其已获悉在某些场景下实现远程代码执行的概念验证。

sentences.en: Fixes shipped in Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 .
The reach is wide.
sentences.zh: 覆盖范围很广。

sentences.en: Veria Labs reports that Ruby on Rails and classic-style Sinatra applications reach the bug in their default configuration, before any authentication.
sentences.zh: Veria Labs报告称，Ruby on Rails和经典风格的Sinatra应用程序在任何身份验证之前，都会在其默认配置中遇到该漏洞。

sentences.en: Self-hosted products that bundle Ruby, including GitLab, GitHub Enterprise Server, Mastodon, OpenProject, Discourse and Chatwoot, shipped an affected Ruby in their latest release at the time of disclosure.
sentences.zh: 在披露时，捆绑了Ruby的自托管产品（包括GitLab、GitHub Enterprise Server、Mastodon、OpenProject、Discourse和Chatwoot）在其最新版本中附带了受影响的Ruby。

sentences.en: Cloudflare WAF blocks ruby2shell for all customers, including those on the Free plan.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare WAF 为所有客户（包括使用免费套餐的客户）拦截 ruby2shell。

sentences.en: We have added two rules to both the Cloudflare Free Managed Ruleset and the Cloudflare Managed Ruleset, with Block as the default action: one for ruby2shell and one for GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px, a related integer overflow in Ruby string case conversion fixed in the same releases.
sentences.zh: 我们在Cloudflare免费托管规则集和Cloudflare托管规则集中各添加了两条规则，默认操作为“阻止”：一条针对ruby2shell，另一条针对GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px，后者是Ruby字符串大小写转换中存在的一个相关整数溢出问题，已在同一版本中得到修复。

sentences.en: The WAF is a compensating control, not a replacement for patching.
sentences.zh: WAF是一种补偿性控制措施，而不是对补丁的替代。

sentences.en: Exploits can reach the bug through paths a WAF does not see, and the only complete fix is to upgrade Ruby.
sentences.zh: 漏洞攻击可以通过WAF无法察觉的路径触及该漏洞，唯一的彻底补救措施是升级Ruby。

sentences.en: Our team continues to monitor attack traffic and will update the rules as new techniques appear.
sentences.zh: 我们的团队将持续监控攻击流量，并在出现新技术时更新规则。

items.title: How Cloudflare WAF helps protect against phpAfterShell and other critical PHP flaws

sentences.en: How Cloudflare WAF helps protect against phpAfterShell and other critical PHP flaws.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare WAF如何帮助防范phpAfterShell和其他关键PHP漏洞。

sentences.en: On November 19, 2026, the security research company depthfirst disclosed phpAfterShell (CVE-2026-126714) , a vulnerability in PHP's default file-based session handler that can lead to remote code execution.
sentences.zh: 2026 年 11 月 19 日，安全研究公司 depthfirst 披露了 phpAfterShell（CVE-2026-126714） ，这是 PHP 默认文件型会话处理程序中的一个漏洞，可能导致远程代码执行。

sentences.en: Under the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) 4.0, it scores 9.2 out of 10 (Critical).
sentences.zh: 根据通用漏洞评分系统（CVSS）4.0，其得分为10分中的9.2分（严重）。

sentences.en: The PHP project fixed it the same day in versions 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28, 8.5.13, and 8.6.0.
sentences.zh: PHP 项目在同一天发布的 8.2.36、8.3.37、8.4.28、8.5.13 和 8.6.0 版本中修复了该漏洞。

sentences.en: These releases fix 16 other security vulnerabilities, six of them also rated critical.
sentences.zh: 这些版本修复了另外16个安全漏洞，其中6个也被评为“严重”。

sentences.en: Cloudflare’s web application firewall (WAF) blocks known phpAfterShell attack patterns, including for customers on the Free plan.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare 的 Web 应用防火墙 (WAF) 会拦截已知的 phpAfterShell 攻击模式，包括针对使用免费套餐的客户的攻击。

sentences.en: The protection comes from a PHP remote code execution rule we first deployed in October 2026 for the php2shell vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 该保护措施源自我们于 2026 年 10 月首次针对 php2shell 漏洞部署的 PHP 远程代码执行规则。

sentences.en: That rule already detected part of the phpAfterShell attack pattern before the vulnerability was disclosed, and on November 19 we updated its detection logic to cover phpAfterShell.
sentences.zh: 在漏洞披露之前，该规则已经检测到部分 phpAfterShell 攻击模式，11 月 19 日，我们更新了其检测逻辑，以涵盖 phpAfterShell。

sentences.en: The rule is part of both the Cloudflare Free Managed Ruleset and the Cloudflare Managed Ruleset, is enabled by default, and its default action is Block.
sentences.zh: 该规则同时属于Cloudflare免费托管规则集和Cloudflare托管规则集，默认启用，其默认操作为“阻止”。

sentences.en: In the same WAF release, we added three new rules to the Cloudflare Managed Ruleset for paid plans: one for a request smuggling flaw in PHP-FPM (CVE-2026-129289), and two for flaws in PHP's SOAP extension (CVE-2026-15353 and CVE-2026-129506) that PHP fixed in the same releases.
sentences.zh: 在同一版本的 WAF 中，我们为付费套餐的 Cloudflare 管理规则集新增了三条规则：一条针对 PHP-FPM 中的请求走私漏洞（CVE-2026-129289），另外两条针对 PHP 的 SOAP 扩展中的漏洞（CVE-2026-15353 和 CVE-2026-129506），这些漏洞已在同一版本的 PHP 中得到修复。

sentences.en: These rules are enabled by default with the Log action, because the request patterns they look for can also appear in legitimate traffic, and blocking by default could disrupt it.
sentences.zh: 这些规则默认情况下会启用“记录”操作，因为它们要查找的请求模式也可能出现在合法流量中，而默认情况下进行拦截可能会中断合法流量。

sentences.en: Customers can review matching requests in Security Events now and change the action to Block once they confirm the rules do not affect legitimate traffic.
sentences.zh: 客户现在可以在“安全事件”中查看匹配的请求，并在确认规则不会影响合法流量后，将操作更改为“阻止”。

items.title: How Watch Duty is using Gemini to get wildfire alerts out faster

sentences.en: How Watch Duty is using Gemini to get wildfire alerts out faster.
sentences.zh: Watch Duty如何使用Gemini更快地发出森林大火警报。

sentences.en: Watch Duty uses Gemini to turn noisy fire radio into text, spotting wildfire dispatches in under 30 seconds so alerts go out faster.
sentences.zh: Watch Duty使用Gemini将嘈杂的消防无线电转换为文本，在30秒内识别出森林大火的调度信息，从而更快地发出警报。
